definitions.explanation: A tiny bird of the Americas that beats its wings so fast it can hover in the air while it drinks nectar from flowers. Not found wild in Japan.

examples.japanese: ハチドリ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧。

examples.english: A hummingbird is sipping nectar from a flower.

examples.japanese: ハチドリ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{羽|はね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{動|うご}かして→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧、⟦{空中|くうちゅう}→空中：21842_kuuchuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A hummingbird beats its wings extremely fast and can stay still in midair.

notes:
⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧ (bee) + ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧ (bird), from its bee-like humming and hovering; the kanji spelling is {蜂鳥|はちどり}.
